definitions.gloss: old age; post-retirement years; later years of life
definitions.explanation: The period of life after retirement, typically from one's 60s onward. A frequent topic in discussions about finances, health, and life planning. Composed of 老 (old) + 後 (after).

examples.japanese: {老後|ろうご}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{貯金|ちょきん}→貯金：03497_chokin⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I am saving money for my retirement years.

examples.japanese: {老後|ろうご}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{田舎|いなか}→田舎：01320_inaka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{暮|く}らしたい→暮らす：01937_kurasu⟧。
examples.english: I want to live in the countryside in my old age.

examples.japanese: {老後|ろうご}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{不安|ふあん}→不安：00836_fuan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えている→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: More and more people feel anxious about their post-retirement life.

notes:
USAGE:
{老後|ろうご} is a very common word in discussions about life planning, finances, and social welfare. The phrase {老後|ろうご}⟦{資金|しきん}→資金：09937_shikin⟧ (retirement funds) and concerns about {老後|ろうご}⟦{破産|はさん}→破産：03555_hasan⟧ (retirement bankruptcy) are frequent topics in Japanese media.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {老後|ろうご}⟦{資金|しきん}→資金：09937_shikin⟧ (retirement funds)
- {老後|ろうご}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{備|そな}え→備え：11620_sonae⟧ (preparing for old age)
- {老後|ろうご}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧ (post-retirement life)
- {老後|ろうご}⟦{破産|はさん}→破産：03555_hasan⟧ (retirement bankruptcy)
- {老後|ろうご}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{過|す}ごす→過ごす：02062_sugosu⟧ (to spend one's later years)
